# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 7 tokens; Text — 6 tokens; Borders and rings — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 53 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 18 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 5 tokens; Gradient — 7 tokens; Border width — 4 tokens; Opacity — 3 tokens; Duration — 4 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens; Layout — 12 tokens; Z index — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--background, #f5f7fa);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #f5f7fa;
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--background` | #f5f7fa | App page ground behind everything. |
| `--background-subtle` | #eef1f6 | Sidebar, section wells, segmented-control track. |
| `--surface` | #fbfcfe | Neutral Surface material: cards, inputs, list panels. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | Elevated Surface material: menus, popovers, toasts, modals, player bar. |
| `--surface-inverse` | #141821 | Tooltips and the primary button fill. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light |
| --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | #ebeef4 |
| `--surface-pressed` | #e2e6ee |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 56px/60px Manrope, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.03em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 56px / 60px, letter-spacing -0.03em | 600 | `sans` | Hero and splash titles only; one per screen. |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 40px / 46px, letter-spacing -0.025em | 600 | `sans` | Album, artist and playlist page titles. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 30px / 36px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Section headers on home and library. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 22px / 28px, letter-spacing -0.015em | 600 | `sans` | Shelf titles, modal titles. |
| `h4` | `.h4`, `--text-h4` | 18px / 24px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | FeaturedCard title, drawer headers. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 17px / 26px, letter-spacing -0.005em | 400 | `sans` | Editorial descriptions, artist bios. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI copy, track titles (weight 500). |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Artist lines, card subtitles, menu hints. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.005em | 400 | `sans` | Helper text, timestamps. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 16px | 500 | `sans` | Form labels, nav items, chips, tabs. |
| `button` | `.button`, `--text-button` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Button labels (sm uses 13px). |
| `overline` | `.overline`, `--text-overline` | 11px / 14px, letter-spacing 0.12em | 600 | `sans` | UPPERCASE category labels on collectible cards and section kickers. |

## Spacing

4px base. Primitives space-1…space-20; semantic insets give dense lists, medium cards and spacious heroes different rhythms.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-0-5);
```

### Tokens (18)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-0-5` | 2px | Optical nudges, badge vertical padding. |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-text in badges, collectible frame padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Icon-to-label gap, TrackRow vertical padding. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Control horizontal padding, card inner padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Default gap between related blocks; mobile gutter. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Card grid gap on tablet. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Panel padding; card grid gap on desktop. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Desktop gutter; gap between shelf title and shelf. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Gap between page header and content. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Between sections on home. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Hero vertical padding (tablet). |
| `--space-20` | 80px | Hero vertical padding (desktop), splash. |
| `--inset-row` | 8px | DENSE — TrackRow, QueueItem, menu item vertical padding. |
| `--inset-card` | 12px | MEDIUM — card metadata padding. |
| `--inset-panel` | 24px | Popover, modal, drawer padding. |
| `--inset-hero` | 80px | SPACIOUS — hero and featured banner padding. |
| `--gap-grid` | 24px | Card grid gap (desktop). |
| `--gap-section` | 48px | Vertical rhythm between page sections. |

## Radius

Six steps. Nesting rule: outer = inner + padding (card 14 = md 10 + space-1 4).

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-xs: 4px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-xs), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-xs` | 4px | Checkbox, badges, tags, cover thumbs in rows. |
| `--radius-sm` | 6px | Small buttons, chips-in-inputs, tooltips, menu items. |
| `--radius-md` | 10px | Buttons, inputs, menus, card artwork inside a frame. |
| `--radius-card` | 14px | All media cards and the collectible frame. |
| `--radius-lg` | 20px | Modals, drawers, hero panels. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Chips, switches, avatars, the Play button, search input. |

Depth comes first from tone and borders; shadows are cool, low and short.

### Use


| token | value | usage |

| `--shadow-floating` | 0 10px 28px -8px rgba(20,24,33,0.14), 0 2px 6px rgba(20,24,33,0.05) | Menus, popovers, toasts, player bar. |

## Gradient

Iridescent material. Rare by rule: brand, the play action, playing/selected state, featured cards, progress. Never a page or panel background, never the only carrier of meaning.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--iridescent-primary: linear-gradient(115deg, #b8eef7 0%, #b9c8ff 34%, #d2c2ff 62%, #f5c3ec 90%, #d3f3e6 100%)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--iridescent-primary), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--iridescent-primary` | linear-gradient(115deg, #b8eef7 0%, #b9c8ff 34%, #d2c2ff 62%, #f5c3ec 90%, #d3f3e6 100%) | Fill of the iridescent Button and the Play button. Ink text/icons on it (10:1+). |
| `--iridescent-soft` | linear-gradient(115deg, #effbfd 0%, #eef1ff 40%, #f4efff 72%, #fdf0fa 100%) | Featured card ground, splash. Barely-there pearl. |
| `--iridescent-border` | linear-gradient(135deg, #1b86a8 0%, #3d5cff 38%, #7a4cf5 70%, #c0459f 100%) | 1.5px ring on the Play button, playing cards and the brand symbol. |
| `--iridescent-foil` | conic-gradient(from 210deg, #7fd6ea, #93a8ff, #b9a2ff, #eaa2da, #a9e6cf, #7fd6ea) | Collectible frame of FeaturedCard only. |
| `--iridescent-highlight` | linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.7) 48%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 66%) | Foil glint swept slowly across a featured image on hover (duration-holo). |
| `--iridescent-progress` | linear-gradient(90deg, #1b86a8 0%, #3d5cff 45%, #7a4cf5 78%, #c0459f 100%) | Active track of the player ProgressBar; underline of the active TopNavItem. |
| `--iridescent-selected` | linear-gradient(90deg, #e3f7fb 0%, #e6ebff 50%, #f1e9ff 100%) | Now-playing TrackRow and QueueItem ground. Paired with the PlaybackState bars. |

### Use


| `--border-hairline` | 1px | Subtle, default, strong and interactive borders. |
| `--border-thick` | 1.5px | Selected and iridescent borders. |
| `--focus-ring-width` | 2px | Focus outline width. |
| `--focus-ring-offset` | 2px | Focus outline offset — clears the element's own border. |

## Duration

Motion tokens. Holo motion is the slowest and rarest; all motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--duration-fast: 120ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--duration-fast), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--duration-fast` | 120ms | Hover fills, icon swaps, press. |
| `--duration-normal` | 200ms | Menus, popovers, tooltips, card lift, player state. |
| `--duration-slow` | 320ms | Drawer, modal, toast enter. |
| `--duration-holo` | 2400ms | Foil glint sweep on FeaturedCard hover. Once per hover, never looped. |

One system, three widths. Mobile < 768 ≤ Tablet < 1200 ≤ Desktop.

